ndf056f1fe3.headline: Oil prices reach highest levels since late February
ndf056f1fe3.summary: Saudi Arabia announced cuts in crude oil production while other OPEC+ members plan only marginal increases in coming months, pushing oil prices to their highest since late February.
ndf056f1fe3.why: Saudi Arabia is the largest OPEC producer and its production decisions strongly influence global oil supply and prices, affecting energy markets and inflation worldwide.
